# COORD-MU-LIFT — Full-prefix amplitude E(B) and Newton/Heath-Brown lift

- **Family:** mobius-side
- **Notation:** E(B), G(B), K1, K2, K3
- **Definition:** E(B) = max_{1<=n<B} |M(n)|/sqrt(n); M(X) = 2M(N) + K1 - K2 + K3 for N = B - 1, B <= X < B^2.
